newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Chevalier to buy building for S$11.5 mln.
newsitem.headline: Chevalier to buy building for S$11.5 mln.

text.p: Building materials and engineering company Chevalier Singapore Holdings Ltd said on Tuesday it had agreed to buy an industrial building in Singapore for Singapore $11.5 million.

The company said in a statement the purchase, to be financed by internal resources and bank borrowings, would not have any material impact on its net tangible assets and earnings per share for the financial year ending March 31, 1997.
The new building would be Chevalier's second industrial property, it said.
